categories.name: Countries other than India with wild tigers

fun_fact: Earlier this week we celebrated Global Tiger Day. India's Project Tiger, launched in the 1970s, is a huge conservation success story — the country today has more than 3,000 tigers in the wild, the highest of any nation. But their habitat remains under threat: right now the Panna Tiger Reserve, home to around 70 tigers, is endangered by the proposed Ken-Betwa river-linking project. [Read more](https://www.newslaundry.com/2026/06/16/ken-betwa-project-drying-a-river-sacrificing-a-tiger-reserve-interview-with-amit-bhatnagar)
